about_the_game:
• A compulsory course in the School of Economics and Management at the university, featuring a super hardcore simulation business game.You will play as the chairman of a startup company, participate in market competition, utilize limited resources to survive in fierce market competition, and understand the operational logic of modern business in the game.
1. The gameplay of the game always revolves around two goals: producing products and selling products.
How to produce products? You can:
　　Building a factory building
　　Building a production line
　　Research and development products
　　Purchasing raw materials
　　produce products
How to sell products? You can:
　　expand a market
　　Advertising placement
　　Get order
　　submit order
Your enterprise is constantly growing in the economic cycle of "production and sales".
2. There is AI in the game competing with you in the market.There are 11 difficulty levels, and as the difficulty level increases, market competition will become increasingly fierce, and AI's budget ability will also become stronger. The budget ability of the last difficulty level AI will become very strong, and your ability will gradually improve in the process of competing with AI.
3. Victory condition: Ranking in the top 3 by the end of the game.

  • You will learn to read financial statements.Financial statements are a physical examination report of a company, which can reveal whether the company is healthy and whether it has development prospects in the future.
  • You will learn to fill out budget forms.Everything is established in advance, and failure to do so leads to failure. A budget table is a strategic map that spans space and time. When you can proficiently fill out a budget table, you seem to have the ability to "control the overall situation and predict the future".
  • You will develop a pair of eyes that can see economic flow.Accounting is a business language that records economic flows, and every business activity in the game generates corresponding accounting entries in real time. You will learn to see economic flows through accounting entries.
  • After you complete the game, your budget, finance, logic, overall coordination, and management abilities will have a significant improvement, which will be very helpful for your learning and work.
  • This game is suitable for making a cup of tea in a quiet afternoon or evening, then opening your own music player, opening the Excel budget table, listening to songs, and concentrating on the budget bit by bit without distractions.It may take 20 minutes to budget for a business year, but the actual operation only takes 3 minutes. Once you become familiar with the rules, you can start enjoying the thrill of your brain running at high speed during budgeting.
